pages.text: Every placed head has a $(l)title$(): the cow is the Canteen Supervisor.$(br2)Use one with an empty hand: the bell rings, it nods and says something. HR translates.$(br2)Fed, it does its $(l)desk job$().
$(l)Lunch$(): use the bucket on the plinth. The bowl holds 1,000 mB, three days of lunch. A cow head within 8 makes it last 10%% longer. The first lunch hires a trophy; then pipes may feed it too.

$(l)Desk Jobs$()$(br)Items are used on the head, fed.$(br)$(l)Villager$(): rung with an emerald in hand, reads its best offer.$(br)$(l)Cow$(): broth near it lasts longer.$(br)$(l)Sheep$(): shears, wool daily; dye, a new colour.
pages.title: Form 41-D

pages.text: $(l)Mooshroom$(): a bowl, stew daily; a brown one fed a flower, suspicious stew.$(br)$(l)Chicken$(): clucks the hour; a feather at dawn.$(br)$(l)Blaze$(): furnaces it touches cook 25%% faster.$(br)$(l)Evoker$(): turns a blue sheep within 8 red.
pages.title: Form 41-D (2)

pages.text: $(l)Cat$(): creepers keep 6 blocks off, phantoms 16; a dawn gift if its employer slept.$(br)$(l)Ghast$(): a tear at dawn; a wail at night.$(br)$(l)Frog$(): croaks a minute before rain.$(br)$(l)Squid$(): a glass bottle, an ink sac daily.
pages.title: Form 41-D (3)

pages.text: $(l)Piglin$(): a gold ingot, one barter. Off a Nether block, out of the Nether, it turns in 15 s.$(br)$(l)Allay$(): use an item on it: every 30 s it fetches one like it within 16 into a chest it touches.
pages.title: Form 41-D (4)

pages.text: $(l)Goat$(): rung, rams its glass: a horn, twice ever.$(br)$(l)Sniffer$(): on dirt, grass, moss or mud, a seed at dawn.$(br)$(l)Iron Golem$(): villager heads within 16 cheer up; a poppy on the first ring of the day.
pages.title: Form 41-D (5)

pages.text: $(l)Zombie$(): knocks on a door when someone comes near.$(br)$(l)Warden$(): logs every sound within 16; rung, reads out the last five. Over 20 a minute: -5 morale. At Grievance, one shriek: Darkness, 10 s, within 16.
pages.title: Form 41-D (6)

pages.text: $(l)Morale$() sets the pace: Engaged, a fifth faster; Disengaged, half speed, and it complains every two minutes. A Disengaged ghast cries two tears.$(br2)$(o)A head taken off its plinth says goodbye. It leaves the stapler.$()
